subject: Archaeology
title: The Step Pyramid: Egypt's First
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Step Pyramid: Egypt's First usable.

hook.text: Before the Great Pyramid, there was a first try. It looked like six boxes stacked on top of each other.

buildup.text: Imhotep designed the Step Pyramid at Saqqara around 2670 BCE for Pharaoh Djoser. It was revolutionary.

discovery.text: It was the first monumental stone building in human history — a leap from mud brick to cut limestone.

twist.text: Imhotep was not a king. He was an architect, doctor, and priest — later worshipped as a god of medicine.

climax.text: The Step Pyramid proved stone could be stacked to the sky. Every later pyramid owes its existence to this one.

punchline.text: The world's first architect became a god. Not bad for a commoner.

quiz.question: Why is the Step Pyramid at Saqqara historically significant?
options: It was the tallest structure in the ancient world for 1,000 years
It was the first monumental stone building in human history
It contained the largest collection of Egyptian texts ever found

details.summary: The Step Pyramid at Saqqara, built around 2670 BCE for Pharaoh Djoser, was Egypt's first monumental stone structure. Designed by architect Imhotep, it evolved from a flat mastaba tomb into a six-tiered pyramid, revolutionizing Egyptian architecture forever.
details.whyItMatters: The Step Pyramid represents humanity's first large-scale stone building. It launched a tradition of pyramid construction that defined Egypt and demonstrated the organizational power of early states.
takeaways: Built around 2670 BCE for Pharaoh Djoser at Saqqara
Architect Imhotep pioneered monumental stone construction
It evolved from a flat mastaba into a six-tiered pyramid

faq.question: Who was Imhotep and why is he important?
faq.answer: Imhotep was Djoser's chief architect, priest, and physician. He invented the concept of stacking stone mastabas to create the pyramid form. Later Egyptians revered him as a god of wisdom, and he remains one of the earliest named architects in human history.

faq.question: How does the Step Pyramid differ from later pyramids?
faq.answer: The Step Pyramid has six distinct tiers rather than smooth sloping sides. Later pyramids at Giza achieved true geometric form with smooth limestone casing. The Step Pyramid was the experimental prototype that made those later achievements possible.
